name: Shikanjvi (Punjabi Spiced Lemonade)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Pour the water into a glass.
Add the lemon juice, ginger, sugar, salt and pepper, then shake it vigorously.

culture.text: Shikanjvi is a type of traditional limeade or lemonade from the Punjab region of South Asia. While the base ingredients include lemon or lime juice, ginger juice, ice and water, shikanjvi often contains other ingredients such as salt, saffron, mint, rosewater, or cumin.
